page_title: ATA 2-0 BOL | Atalanta v Bologna 13/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Emil Holm (Bologna) but poses no threat.
90+3' Juan Miranda (Bologna) has tested the patience of referee Maurizio Mariani and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' The free kick is delivered by Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
89' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
87' Remo Freuler (Bologna) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
85' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Davide Zappacosta is replaced by Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta).
83' Remo Freuler (Bologna) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball high over the crossbar. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt.
82' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
81' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Raoul Bellanova walks off the pitch to be replaced by Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ademola Lookman departs the field of play to be replaced by Marco Brescianini (Atalanta).
80' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) replacing Mateo Retegui.
79' The referee signals a corner kick to Bologna.
79' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
78' 4:9 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
77' Nicolo Casale is substituted due to injury. Vincenzo Italiano gives a chance to Martin Erlic (Bologna).
75' Juan Miranda (Bologna) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
73' Ederson (Atalanta) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
72' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) will take the corner.
71' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play and Atalanta manage to earn a corner.
71' The manager makes a subsitution with Emil Holm (Bologna) coming on for Lorenzo De Silvestri.
70' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
68' A lofted cross from Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

67' Nicolo Casale (Bologna) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies inches over the crossbar.
66' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Maurizio Mariani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
65' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is out of play. Atalanta will have a throw-in.
64' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
63' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
62' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
60' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Maurizio Mariani lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
60' The referee points to the corner flag and Bologna will take a corner.

59' Juan Miranda (Bologna) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) drills a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.
58' Atalanta quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
57' The ball is cleared after Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Atalanta get a corner.
57' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Atalanta will take a throw-in.
56' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

55' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
54' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
53' Maurizio Mariani blows the whistle, Ederson (Atalanta) is penalised for a foul.
51' Nicolo Casale (Bologna) jumps into a tackle and Maurizio Mariani signals a foul.
50' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but Federico Ravaglia punches the ball away.
49' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) fires a volley towards the left side of the goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save.
48' A cross into the box from Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) is cleared.
46' The game is over for Jhon Lucumi (Bologna). Nicolo Casale comes on for the second half.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is replaced by Benjamin Dominguez.
46' Vincenzo Italiano makes a switch. Nicolo Cambiaghi is coming on in place of Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+4' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. It's a throw-in for Bologna.
45+3' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
45+2' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Gian Piero Gasperini is forced to make a change. Sead Kolasinac is unable to continue due to injury, Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) comes on.
44' The game is interrupted now, Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
43' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
42' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
40' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) sends a long ball in, but Marco Carnesecchi comfortably gathers the ball.
39' Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul after Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
38' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle as Ederson (Atalanta) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
37' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Dan Ndoye (Bologna) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
36' Corner kick. Bologna will have an opportunity.

35' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) latches on to a pin-point pass on the edge of the box and fires the ball towards the left post, but the goalkeeper performs an amazing acrobatic dive to deny him. The strike bounces off his gloves and hits the post. The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
35' Bologna are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
34' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Maurizio Mariani had an easy-decision to make.
33' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

33' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atalanta.
32' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
32' Poor challenge! Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) is penalised for tripping and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle. Bologna get a free kick.
30' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
29' Ederson (Atalanta) is put clean through inside the box by Mateo Retegui, but he gets right under the ball and sends it just over the bar. Should have been a goal!
28' Atalanta are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
27' The resulting corner from Juan Miranda (Bologna) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
26' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bologna.
24' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
21' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Mateo Retegui plays it into the box, and Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
21' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) sends a long ball in, but Marco Carnesecchi comfortably gathers the ball.
20' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
19' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
18' Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
16' Bologna are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
14' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) takes the corner but it's cleared.
13' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta). Atalanta will take a corner kick.
12' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
11' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
10' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
9' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Federico Ravaglia intercepts the ball.
8' Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight and sees a foul from Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta).
7' Isak Hien (Atalanta) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
6' A raking crossfield pass from Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
5' The ball has crossed the sideline. Atalanta are taking a throw-in.
4' The Bologna players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' 1 - 0 Goal! Raoul Bellanova provides Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Maurizio Mariani.
